st: Food Fight; Please Don't Feed the Turners
d: Timmy wishes that his mother were a better cook; the Turners win a trip to space.

st: Jerk of All Trades; Snack Attack
d: Timmy helps Jorgen find a new job after he is fired; Sparky makes his own magic dog treats.
Timmy must find a replacement for his father in the Father-Son Squirrelly Scout competition; Vicky baby-sits Timmy at her house.

st: Vicky Loses Her Icky; Pixies Inc.
d: A magical bug containing her evil essence crawls out of Vicky, leaving a sweet and docile teenager; boring creatures called Pixies who treat magic like a business buy Fairy World.
Timmy wishes for Vicky to find the perfect boyfriend; Timmy wishes that he were the funniest person on Earth.
Cosmo is chosen to be the host of the secret fairy convention; Timmy sends Wanda to a spa for a day off.

st: The Odd Squad; For Emergencies Only
d: After Timmy wishes for a talking car, he goes on an adventure in Fairy World with Wanda, Poof and "Carsmo"; Timmy convinces Cosmo and Wanda to give him his own magic wand with 10 wishes on it.
Timmy and Chloe wish that their families go camping together, but there is a feud between their parents. Chloe wishes to be a mother so she can go to Dimmsdale Daze Carnival with Timmy.
Timmy borrows Mark Chang's Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie's costume party; Cosmo must enforce the rules when Jorgen comes down with the Trick-ups.

st: A New Squid in Town; Wish Fixers
d: Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in hiding from his fiancé; Timmy must undergo a program that will teach him to make responsible wishes.

st: Turning Into Turner; The Wand That Got Away
d: Crocker pretends to be future Timmy using stolen DNA; Timmy and the others chip in to help Cosmo find his lost wand.
Timmy wishes his father had a cooler job; Timmy enters the Dimm-a-dance Film Festival to impress Trixie Tang.

st: Cheese and Crockers; Land Before Timmy
d: Timmy wishes for a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy and half-something else; when Timmy wishes for a simpler world, everyone is transported to prehistoric times.
Timmy wishes for 12 hours of pure darkness; the Turners are stranded on a deserted island.
Cosmo and Wanda receive invitations to their high-school reunion; Timmy wishes he were the strongest guy on the beach.
Timmy wishes that the whole world could be like his Crimson Chin comic book.

st: Cat 'n Mouse; Chip off the Old Crock
d: Timmy and Chloe help the depressed Catman prove to his girlfriend that he is a real superhero; Mr. Crocker teaches his nephew Kevin Crocker how to become a Fairy Hunter.

st: Sleep Over and Over; Mother Nature
d: Timmy gets caught in the middle of a feud between Chester and A.J.; Timmy's mother starts predicting the weather.
After deciding she wants to be an actress, Vicky forces Timmy to help her get her first role; Dad flushes Timmy and the fairies down the toilet.
Timmy's father turns their home into a farm; Mr. Crocker tries to expose monsters on a web show.

st: Catman Meets the Crimson Chin; Genie Meanie Minie Moe
d: Timmy tries to help the star of a superhero television show; Timmy accidentally releases a genie from a magic lava lamp.

The Squirrely Scouts go into space to plant a flag on unfamiliar terrain, hoping to achieve a special Squirrely Scout status; Chloe spends the summer vacation studying, but her inner child disagrees and causes her to make crazy wishes in her sleep.
Patrick wakes up off-model; the Star family works at the Krusty Krab.
Patrick spawns a mini-Patrick who becomes the star of the show, until he outgrows the role; the Star family celebrates the Klopnodian holiday Swaptoberfest by swapping identities with each other.

st: Squidina's Little Helper; I Smell a Pat
d: Squidina hires an assistant who's a little too good at his job; the Patrick Star Show is interrupted by a most peculiar stench.

st: At Home, On the Lam; Pick Patrick's Path
d: Bunny tries to punish Patrick for chocolate-favored crimes; the Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next.

st: Wet Painters; Krusty Krab Training Video
d: SpongeBob and Patrick paint Mr. Krabs's living room; Krusty Krab training video.
The Flying Dutchman takes up residence at SpongeBob's house; the beneficiaries of Sandy's treedome pay her a visit.
SpongeBob visits the dreams of others; SpongeBob comes down with the sniffles.
SpongeBob suspects Patrick of stealing his jellyfishing net; SpongeBob builds a ventriloquist dummy modeled after Squidward.

st: The Lost Mattress; Krabs vs. Plankton
d: SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward buy Mr. Krabs a new mattress; Plankton sues Mr. Krabs after falling at the Krusty Krab.
SpongeBob hides from Sandy; SpongeBob and Patrick borrow a balloon from a store and accidentally pop it.

st: Jellyfish Hunter; The Fry Cook Games
d: SpongeBob brings herds of jellyfish to Mr. Krabs; Patrick gets a job at the Chum Bucket and competes with SpongeBob in the Fry Cook Games.
SpongeBob takes his turn as hall monitor; SpongeBob brings home a wild jellyfish.
Mr. Krabs sells his restaurant and goes into early retirement; Squidward convinces SpongeBob that he has a laugh-related illness.
SpongeBob micromanages an all-out shindig for the denizens of Bikini Bottom.

st: Whale of a Birthday; Karate Island
d: Mr. Krabs wants to throw a birthday party for Pearl; SpongeBob receives an invitation to take part in a competition.
SpongeBob tries to make a special Valentine for his best friend Patrick; SpongeBob has some fun with a piece of paper Squidward threw away.
Gary runs away from home when SpongeBob forgets to feed him.
